description: Preview quality canon for contact sheets, preview renders, and review artifacts.

quality_dimensions.name: Frame Uniqueness
quality_dimensions.description: Preview frames must show meaningful variation.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Duplicate frame ratio below 10%. Each frame adds review value.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Duplicate frame ratio above 10%. Static or near-static preview.

quality_dimensions.name: Scene Progression
quality_dimensions.description: Preview must convey narrative or visual progression.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Preview shows change, movement, or story development.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Preview is a single static image or shows no progression.

quality_dimensions.name: Contact Sheet Usefulness
quality_dimensions.description: Contact sheet must aid operator review and selection.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Thumbnails readable. Layout aids comparison. Labels present.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Thumbnails too small to evaluate. Layout confusing. Missing labels.

quality_dimensions.name: Path Validity
quality_dimensions.description: All paths referenced in preview metadata must resolve.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Every referenced asset path exists on disk.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Broken asset references in preview metadata.
